{{Lunisolar April}} 
'''April 1''' is the 1st day of month {{ill|April (Lunisolar)|ja|4月 (旧暦)|lt=April (Uzuki)}}  the 4th month of the traditional {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦}} . It's {{ill|Rokuyō|ja|六曜}}  day is {{ill|Butsumetsu|ja|仏滅|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q10886789}} . 
== Events ==
* [[Kansei]]{{efn|January 1789 through February 1801|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}  4th Year ({{ill|Gregorian calendar|en|Gregorian calendar|qid=Q12138|lt=Gregorian calendar}}  {{ill|1792|en|1792|qid=Q7805|lt=1792 AD}}  {{ill|May 21|en|May 21|qid=Q2580|lt=May 21}} ) – At {{ill|Mount Unzen|en|Mount Unzen|qid=Q620860|lt=Unzen-dake}} , which had been erupting continuously since February, part of the mountain collapsed. Debris flowed into the {{ill|Shimabara Sea|ja|島原海|qid=Q140447135}} , triggering a {{ill|Tsunami|en|Tsunami|qid=Q8070|lt=tsunami}} , which also caused damage in {{ill|Higo Province|en|Higo Province|qid=Q259705|lt=Higo}}  on the opposite shore (an event known as {{ill|1792 Unzen landslide and tsunami|en|1792 Unzen landslide and tsunami|qid=Q3591486|lt=Shimabara Great Higo Misfortune}} ).
